name: Phoenix X Server
description:
Phoenix is a modern X11 display server written from scratch in Zig. Conceived as a memory-safe, lightweight alternative to the legacy Xorg server, Phoenix focuses on simplicity, security, and low resource overhead.

Features:
- Written in Zig for enhanced memory safety and predictable execution performance
- Implements core X11 protocols for running traditional Linux graphical applications
- Significantly reduced codebase complexity compared to the monolithic Xorg server
- Low memory footprint and instant startup times
- Ideal for embedded systems, lightweight desktop setups, and X11 experimentation
